name: t0rdix
description: T0rdix — all-in-one open-source developer workspace: secret manager, mock studio, API testing, OpenAPI tools, fake data, team workspace and CLI.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix cli install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix cli run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.cli: npm --prefix cli run build && node cli/dist/index.js
